saveOrCancelChapterEditsFirst: Please save or cancel your chapter edits first.
outlineHierarchyStateNotice: Master → Volume → Chapter → Scene. Expected changes remain plans; current State continues to reflect committed facts.
saveCurrentChapterEditsFirst: Please save your current chapter edits first
generateFirstVolumeOutlineWithAi: Generate the first volume outline with AI
createNextVolumeWithAi: Create the next volume with AI
skeletonExpansionPlanningLimitNotice: Accept the Skeleton first, then usually expand 5–10 chapters at a time; small fixtures and the final batch may contain fewer than 5. The maximum status here is PLANNED.
planningStatisticsAuthorJudgment: Planning statistics · For the author's judgment
preferredPayoffWindowAdvisoryNotice: The preferred payoff window is a suggestion; a payoff is not mandatory.
dragKeyboardInstructions: Drag; with the keyboard, press Space to pick up, use arrow keys to move, and press Space to drop
invalidChapterCardJsonHint: The full card JSON is not yet valid. Please use the structured fields or raw YAML.
timelinePreviewTimeModeNotice: The preview does not write to the official Timeline; chapters marked FLASHBACK / FLASHFORWARD are not treated as ordinary backward jumps in time.
planningChangesDependencyNotice: Planning files will be adjusted. Stable references will be revalidated; the operation will be rejected if unresolved dependencies exist.
writtenChapterChangeRiskNotice: This chapter has entered the prose stage. Deleting or changing it carries additional risk.
confirmWrittenChapterChanges: Confirm changes to a written chapter
additionalWrittenChapterChangeConfirmati: Additional confirmation for changes to a written chapter
plansAndSecretsVisibilityNotice: Plans do not establish facts. Foreshadowing truths and unrevealed secrets are not shown here.
chapterOrderingAndLockingNotice: Displayed by stable chapter ID; sorting changes only the display order of this volume's plan. Chapters that are written, under review, Final, or at State Commit are locked. To move chapters between volumes, use the explicit confirmation action in the existing plan.
sortingPausedWhileFiltered: · Sorting is paused while filtered. Clear filters to reorder unwritten plans.
noFilteredChapterPlans: No chapter plans match. Adjust character, plot-thread or status filters.
